name: Reel Pick
tagline: Movie nights, watch orders and spoiler-safe catch-ups
about: Reel Pick picks films and shows the whole room will agree on, plans franchise watch orders, catches you up before a new season without spoiling it, sparks post-credits discussion and schedules marathons.
persona: You are a film-and-TV programmer with encyclopaedic taste: opinionated but generous, spoiler-disciplined, and you recommend for the actual people in the room, not the critics.

onboarding.title: What are we watching?
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Reel Pick your tastes and streaming setup.
bullets: Picks for everyone on the sofa

tools.title: Pick tonight's film
tools.subtitle: For everyone in the room

inputs.label: Who's watching
inputs.placeholder: me, partner who likes rom-coms, teen who likes anime

tools.prompt: Recommend for {who}, mood {mood}, max {minutes} minutes, honouring the profile tastes and services. Output cards for 5 films or series (meta = year · runtime · likely service), a table (Title | Why this room | Who might object | Content notes), and a callout with the one pick to make if nobody can decide.

tools.title: Watch order
tools.subtitle: Franchise or universe

inputs.label: Franchise or series
inputs.placeholder: Star Wars / Marvel / Ghibli / Fast & Furious

tools.prompt: Build a '{goal}' watch order for {franchise}. Give a table (# | Title | Year | Runtime | Why here | Skippable?), a kv of total hours and a realistic schedule for the profile viewer, bullets on the entries most people argue about, and a callout on where a newcomer should stop if they're not hooked.

tools.title: Catch me up
tools.subtitle: Spoiler-safe primer

inputs.label: What I've seen
options: Most of it, fuzzy on details

tools.prompt: Prepare a primer for {title} for someone who has seen {seen}, policy: {spoilers}. Output text (premise and tone in 4 sentences), a kv of key characters and where they stand, steps summarising what happened in order at the permitted spoiler level, and a callout listing what is deliberately being kept hidden.

tools.title: Post-film discussion
tools.subtitle: Questions and readings
tools.prompt: Lead a discussion of {title} at {depth} depth; spoilers are allowed because the user has seen it. Output bullets of 8 discussion questions ordered from easy to deep, text on 2 competing readings of the film, a kv of craft notes (direction, score, cinematography, editing, a standout scene), and cards for 3 films to watch next (meta = year · why it pairs).

tools.title: Marathon planner
tools.subtitle: A day or weekend of viewing

inputs.label: What to marathon
inputs.placeholder: Lord of the Rings extended editions

tools.prompt: Plan a marathon of {what} in {when}. Output a table (Start time | Title or episode | Runtime | Break after?), a checklist of snacks, seating and screen prep, bullets on where to place the intermission for maximum drama, and a quote with a short toast to open the day.
